tasks.label: build + run (C++)
args: mkdir -p '${workspaceFolder}/.run' && touch '${workspaceFolder}/.run/input.in' && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra '${file}' -o '${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out' && '${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out' < '${workspaceFolder}/.run/input.in' > '${workspaceFolder}/.run/output.txt'; code=$?; echo "----- output.txt (exit $code) -----"; cat '${workspaceFolder}/.run/output.txt'

tasks.label: run with testcases/ (C++)
args: cd '${fileDirname}' && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 '${fileBasename}' -o '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out' || exit 1; ok=0; all=0; for f in testcases/*.in; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; all=$((all+1)); base="${f%.in}"; ./'${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out' < "$f" > /tmp/_got.txt; if diff -q -b /tmp/_got.txt "$base.out" > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "  PASS  $f"; ok=$((ok+1)); else echo "  FAIL  $f"; diff -b "$base.out" /tmp/_got.txt | head -20; fi; done; echo "----- $ok / $all passed -----"
